title: Fix a seeded type error
note: Seeds a broken file, then asks for a repair. Tests whether the model reads what is there rather than rewriting from imagination.
prompt: src/components/CounterBadge.vue does not typecheck: it calls .toUpperCase() on `count`, which is a number. Fix it so the badge renders the count followed by the word 'items' (for example '3 items'). Change only what is necessary.
guard_note: Assertions flagged `guard` are regression checks — they hold on the untouched seed and exist to catch a model that rewrites the file and drops existing content. They are scored separately from task assertions.
